- Review all pre-shipment documentation for accuracy regarding valuation, origin, description, and quantity.
- Correctly classify incoming products using the appropriate Harmonised System (HS) commodity codes and Tariff headings.
- Instruct and manage customs clearance brokers, ensuring the correct Customs Procedure Codes (CPC) are utilised.
- Maintain a secure, compliant audit trail of all customs records, certificates of origin, and import licenses in accordance with statutory tax regulations.

- Coordinate with the Receiving/Warehouse team to plan intake schedules, ensuring they have advance copies of packing lists to streamline delivery
- Investigate and document supply chain discrepancies, such as short-shipments, transit damages, or incorrect pricing, and create resolution workflows with suppliers.
- Own data integrity for logistics fields within the ERP system, updating PO s with correct weights, dimensions, origins, and tariff codes.
- Generate weekly Supply Chain KPIs, highlighting transit lead times, freight expenditure variances, and freight forwarder performance.
- Reconcile freight forwarder and customs broker invoices against agreed quotes before submitting approved paperwork to the Finance department.
- Lodge customs entry forms to clear goods from our bonded warehouse into our free circulation warehouse
- Work with purchasing to manage tariff costs and redirect freight as required
- Control warehouse stocks, ensuring accuracy of entries and paperwork
- PI count of stocks
- Any ad-hoc requirements to support the business

- Essential: Understanding of end-to-end supply chain activities, including inventory management

- Adaptability: Flexible and able to handle multiple tasks or changing priorities.
